notes.title: Update: Added Beautiful Swimsuit Illustrations！
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963167/0199e283a3d1a4841223441e303b572cfce8a690.jpg
1、Fixed a performance issue, reducing the memory usage after loading the game.

2、Resolved the issue where HexBlade could not use enchantment skills such as “Flame Enchantment”.

3、Reduced the repetitive labor in the “Harvest Season” event. Now it only takes a very short time and fewer clicks to complete the event, while also increasing its rewards.

4、Added a static swimsuit illustration and a dynamic swimsuit illustration for “Lucia”. The static swimsuit illustration is available in all versions, while the dynamic version is only an update reward for the deluxe edition. 
(You can find the illustration in the img/pictures folder of the game directory and use it as a wallpaper at your discretion)

5、After completing a mission, the teammate's morale will no longer decrease
